title: fix(metadata-protocol,spec)!: a saved view stores the parsed value of every key its body carried, and a ViewItem record's top-level options is refused by name (stage iv of #20051)
body:
Fixes #20051
Clause-②: no

Stage (iv), the last stage, of ruling 甲 (`5856781584`, confirmed `5856866699`), carried out under letter B of ruling `5910106571`. Maintainer verbatim: 「同意  批次 #256」. The stored-row census stays waived: 「20051 不考虑现有的数据」 (`5909085121`). The at-tier contract review is the `domain:spec` seat's, and it is owed before this PR is enqueued. This PR carries no review record of its own.

## What changes

**1. A saved view stores the parsed value of every key its body carried.** `saveMetaItem` now stores `projectStorableViewBody(request.item, parsed.data, reparse)` for `view`, where it used to store the request body with two grafts. The rules:

- An undeclared key is dropped. Every key the console reads back is declared (`VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS`), so nothing it needs is lost.
- A declared key keeps its parsed, normalized value.
- A moved key is stored under its canonical spelling: `groups` → `sections`, and `visibleOn` → `visibleWhen` (never grafted before).
- A schema default the author did not write is not stored. This is ADR-0087's `storable` rule, the one flows follow.

Keys that are moved and defaults look alike in the parse output, so the projection re-parses the body it built. A key the parse added is kept only when the re-parse does NOT reproduce it. The loop ends when the stored body re-parses to exactly the save's parse. If it does not converge, the fallback stores the whole parse output: no key is lost, and a warning is logged once per view. Nothing in today's `view` schema reaches that fallback.

The projection is gated on `singularType === 'view'`, the same way the flow branch is. Every other type keeps its body verbatim with the two grafts. Both grafts still serve other types: `ViewFilterRuleSchema` is reused by page, component and skill schemas, and `FormViewSchema` by component, sharing and field schemas. A page save stays pinned verbatim here as the control.

**2. A ViewItem record's top-level `options` bag is refused by name (Q3 = A).** It is pinned absent on both `ViewItemWireSchema` arms. The response is `422 INVALID_METADATA` at `options`, with the prescription to write `config.KIND`. It uses `z.never()`, not the form overlay's `z.undefined()`, because `ViewItemWire.json` is published on its own and `undefined` has no JSON Schema form. With `z.undefined()` the build refused ("1 previously published schema(s) disappeared"). The ADR-0087 disposition is `registered view-item-options-bag-refused`, a new step-18 semantic entry.

**3. ADR citation.** The five "ADR-0005 §Validation" citations in `protocol.ts` now cite ADR-0005 appendix (c), the "Addendum — 2026-05-16 (c): spec validation on overlay save". The same goes for the one in `view.zod.ts`. `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__metadata-protocol__src__protocol.ts.json` gains ADR-0005 and ADR-0087 with the invariant. No `docs/adr/**` file is edited.

## Measured before the change (the console's own writes at `.objectui-sha` `db11afd4967c`, through the real `saveMetaItem`)

- **W1 to W5**, the toolbar saves of sort, density, hidden fields, column widths and inline edit: the parse adds `type: 'grid'`. Now none is stored. W1 also stops storing its sort row `id`.
- **W6b**, the saved-view toolbar toggle, which writes the whole tab back: `id` and `objectName` are no longer stored.
- **W7 to W9**, config save, create, pin, set-default, reorder and rename: stored unchanged.
- **Form overlay:** it no longer stores `sharing.enabled: false` or the section `collapsible` / `collapsed` / `columns` defaults.
- **Why letter B beats A, measured by ablation 2 below:** storing `parsed.data` whole would have minted toolbar rows that FAIL their own re-save. A column-less patch carrying the `grid` default is refused as "sets `type` but lists no `columns`".

## Pins

- **Re-judged in one round (the full-repo sweep):**
  - metadata-protocol `protocol.graft-folded-form-sections.test.ts`: the two GUARDs and the coexistence case.
    - The Studio round-trip GUARD moves to the list overlay, where the keys are declared. It now covers every key `VIEW_CONSOLE_ROUND_TRIP_KEYS` maps to `listOverlay`.
    - The form overlay now drops `isPinned` / `sortOrder` (undeclared there) and keeps `isDefault`.
    - "A form with canonical `sections` is stored as authored": no section default, no `sharing.enabled`, and no undeclared `isPinned`.
  - objectql `protocol-meta.test.ts`: the declared round-trip keys are stored, and `objectName` is dropped (`object` carries the binding).
  - objectql `protocol-publish-rollback.test.ts`: the diff's added key is the declared `rowHeight`, and the undeclared `extra` never reaches a version.
  - objectql `protocol-view-identity-overlay.test.ts`: the sort row `id` is not stored.
  - spec `view-union-retirement-prescription.test.ts`: the never-leaf population admits a closed two-entry family of pinned-absent refusals. Each entry must be reached and must match its curated text.
- **New**, in the same metadata-protocol file on its pinned engine double:
  - W1 to W5 store no `type`.
  - An undeclared key is dropped (`id`, `objectName`, a form-only `layout`).
  - A declared key keeps its normalized value (`exportOptions`, operator).
  - A key moved inside a moved key is stored canonical, with no default beside it.
  - The persisted body parses to exactly what the save parsed.
  - A record's `options` is refused on both arms, asserting envelope `code` + `status` + path + message, with 0 rows written.
  - The page control.
  - Four structural cases for the helper.
- **New in spec** `view-overlay-options-bag.test.ts`: the record refusal on both arms, plus a control.
- The card body's three pins still stand:
  - A direct and an `options`-wrapped out-of-contract key get the same refusal (door-half block).
  - A legal `options.map` round-trips.
  - The persisted body equals the parse result: the new parse-equivalence pin.

## Evidence (head `41913270bf`)

- **Suites, locked runs:**
  - metadata-protocol full: 191 files, 2819 passed, 19 skipped.
  - objectql full: 345 files, 6778 passed.
  - rest full: 237 files, 4641 passed, 99 skipped.
  - spec `src/ui` + `src/migrations`: 97 files, 3560 passed. The whole spec `local` project also ran before the `origin/main` merge, all green once the retirement-population pin was re-judged.
  - runtime, the 19 files that save or read a view: 990 passed.
- **Typecheck:** spec, metadata-protocol, objectql and lint all exit 0. The spec run chains `check:scripts-typecheck` and `check:test-typecheck`.
- **Ablation 1** (the view branch disabled, and the record refusal renamed away, with `dist/` rebuilt and `ablation-dist-preflight` markers present in both packages):
  - metadata-protocol file: 9 red, 40 green.
  - objectql's three re-judged files: 3 red.
  - spec: 4 red. One of them is the population pin reading the renamed leaf.
  - Restore: blob equals HEAD for both files, markers absent from both `dist/`, and `git status --porcelain` empty.
- **Ablation 2** (store `parsed.data` whole, which is option A): 20 red of 49 in the metadata-protocol file, all five toolbar pins among them. Restored to the HEAD blob.
- **Gates:** `dispatch-gates --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 125.
  - 123 exit 0. `check:engine-split-ratio` first refused on the shallow clone and passed after `fetch --shallow-since`. `check:skill-examples` first refused on a missing client-react `dist` and passed after building it.
  - NOT MEASURED: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:type-check-debt`, both exit 3 PREREQUISITE NOT MET (they need a whole-repo build; CI runs it).
  - `--ran` reconciliation: 0 UNRUN.
  - `check:generated`: all 15 artifacts current; `content/docs/references/ui/view.mdx` was regenerated.
- **eslint (narrowed):**
  - Measured over the 15 changed `.ts` files; each resolves under `eslint --print-config`.
  - `--no-inline-config --format json`: 15 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings.
  - `eslint.config.mjs` enables no type-aware linting (its own comment says so), so this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.

## Docs follow-up (Tier H, separate PR for the maintainer's hand)

ADR-0005 must change in three places:

1. The Status line clause: "and the storage switch itself is the ruling's last stage, not yet landed — see the amendment note under that addendum's persisted-document bullet".
2. Appendix (c): "⚠️ **Ruled, not yet in force:** the storage switch is the ruling's last stage and has not landed, so today `saveMetaItem` still stores the request body (`request.item`)."
3. Appendix (c)'s bullet "The persisted document is the **parsed body** (`parsed.data`) once every round-trip key is declared". Under letter B it becomes: the parsed value of every key the body carried, with no schema default materialised.

## Acceptance notes

- **Other types.** `resolveOverlaySchema` validates every type `getMetadataTypeSchema` registers, not only `view` and `dashboard`, and all of them still store the request body. Widening the projection is its own decision.
- **An objectui read-side drop, present today and independent of this PR.** objectui's adapter flattens a ViewItem record in `listViews` and keeps only `config` plus `name` / `label` / `isDefault`. A saved view's toolbar toggle writes that tab back whole, so it rewrites the row without `isPinned` / `sortOrder` / `visibility` / `columnState`. This is a code read at the pin, not measured in a browser. Its carrier is objectui#11013, the objectui card on aligning console reads.
- **Other stale citations.** "ADR-0005 §Validation" is still cited outside the files this PR touches (for example `packages/metadata-core/src/injected-system-columns.ts:132` and three objectql object-roundtrip test headers). Those stay for the next change that touches them.
